name: Depiction of Pleasure
source:
The world is flooded with a deathly addictive, sandy substance. The arrival of a creature speaking a strange language disrupts the struggles of a king and his loyal follower. Will they discover the nature of the creature and their world?

Depiction of Pleasure is a fantasy adventure story about indulgence, language, and how we view ourselves.

[From [url=https://phwoggers.itch.io/depiction-of-pleasure]Itch.io[/url]]
